title: euphorbia characias subsp. wulfenii
intro: Euphorbia characias subsp. wulfenii, commonly known as the Mediterranean spurge or Wolf's Spurge, is a perennial plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a drought-tolerant shrub native to the Mediterranean region, known for its striking yellow flowers and architectural foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and alleviate pain, attributed to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Euphorbia characias subsp. wulfenii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
